title: Pael's Eye
description: The first time each combat you end your turn without playing cards, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold], and take an extra turn.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic has special interaction with Whispering Earring — on the first turn of combat, if you have both relics, Pael's Eye will consider a card to have been played even if no manual plays occurred.
